predicate.description: Code-owned first failed predicate at the actual check-in boundary; separate from diagnostic predicates.

constrained.description: Observed constraint evidence; omitted false. Constrained facts are retained even when learning rejects them.

device_gb.description: Sampled per-attempt process GPU memory in GiB, not GPU-wide memory.used or an allocator high-water mark. CUDA uses nvidia-smi compute-apps even on unified-memory devices. Sampling is a lower bound; missing means unknown, not zero.

device_unavailable.description: Diagnostic reason no usable process GPU sample was retained. New CUDA/XPU cgroup observers report this when device_gb is absent; older workers may omit both. Does not authorize reduced unified-memory accounting.

events.description: Attempt-parent hierarchical memory.events counts. Absent means not read; explicit zero means a read zero. Max per counter across samples within the attempt.

pressure_unavailable.description: Pressure coverage was missing, malformed or had no valid cumulative-counter time window. Rejects this attempt's memory learning while preserving prior qualified evidence; raw diagnostic peaks remain.

swap_gb.description: Attempt-parent memory.swap.peak in GiB, max across samples. Absent when unavailable; zero is measured. memory.swap.current is pressure evidence only, never a substitute peak.

attempt_history.description: Ended-attempt diagnostic evidence. Open work is pinned; capacity-aware maintenance may compact redundant closed-attempt diagnoses. Immutable custody/learning ledgers remain separate. Historical causes are not reconstructed.

cancellation.description: Read-only cancellation acknowledgement after durable cancellation. Same aggregate release as cancel, including descendants; not_applicable explicitly settles never-attempted work without physical-release evidence.

cancellation_scope.description: Read-only retained fan-out declaration: every piece key, materialization/acceptance, optional wave ID, registered dependent IDs, and flat descendant job/release statuses. Future submissions appear on subsequent reads.

command_started.description: Reply-only answer to whether any attempt's command may have begun, derived from the queue's start acknowledgement on the job or a retained copy and from main execution evidence (may_have_run or unknown). Present on job GET and status job replies; false means no attempt's command began, so resubmission cannot duplicate this job's work.

environment_lock.description: Single-job replies only: the lock_file environment's frozen inputs as sha256 by basename (for Pixi, pixi.lock and pixi.toml) and backend, recorded at acceptance. spec.environment stays projected away.

finished_at.description: Recorded terminal time, when present. Historical terminal records may omit it.

infrastructure_retries.description: Production infrastructure requeues already used. Omitted zero; default maximum is 2, configurable by the queue. Stage failures do not consume this budget.

isolation.description: Native stage exception diagnostic: unsandboxed: followed by the author reason, or the fixed legacy registration reason. Retained across lifecycle and payload redaction.

last_memory_admission.description: Last changed blocking host-memory target comparison in this waiting episode, retained through startup failure and restart. Canonical exact-owner charges, growth and reservation pending state; historical diagnostic, not live usage or proof RAM is the only blocker. Absence is unknown. A retry clears it.

ledger.description: Retained ledger summary: complete is historical coverage, high_water is the last durable sequence. GET /api/jobs/ID/ledger enumerates immutable entries to a fixed high_water. Older incomplete history is explicit; no diagnostic cap applies.

machine.description: Assigned execution identity; omitted before assignment or after requeue.

memory_attempts.description: Persisted memory facts, independent of learning and diagnostic history. Retention follows local capacity and evidence dependencies; open attempts and distinct measurements are preserved. memory_attempts_dropped counts historical evictions. Prelaunch attempts without a peak are omitted. Exact attempt/machine/session, observed memory_peak when available, and the resolved memory_envelope. Missing counters are unknown, not zero. Historical readings cannot be reconstructed.

memory_attempts_dropped.description: Number of historical memory attempt rows evicted by earlier releases. Omitted zero. Prelaunch attempts without a peak do not create rows or increment this count.

reason.description: Sanitized diagnostic only. Do not parse or match its text.

recovered_results.description: Append-only recovery-time evidence linked to exact failed executions. Never changes state, native outcome, ordinary output_refs or dependency eligibility. Metadata and original provenance survive history pruning; bytes expire at each record's expires_at.

release_confirmed.description: Exact current execution release proof when true. Omitted false is not confirmation; older copies may still have pending custody. Use the cancellation acknowledgement for aggregate release.

resource_attempts.description: Per-attempt cumulative CPU and block I/O counters with latest I/O PSI, retaining every distinct attempt. resource_attempts_dropped reports historical evictions. Exact attempt/machine/session fenced; missing counters unknown; process-tree CPU a sampled lower bound. Observational only.

session.description: Worker session of the assigned execution; combine with job ID and attempt.

spec_projection.description: Observation privacy policy: projected is true; omitted lists stripped paths relative to spec, regardless of submitted presence. Empty placeholders do not retain submitted values. Absence of spec.files is not evidence that no files were submitted.

start_by_explicit.description: Whether submitted start_by was caller-owned and absolute. New jobs persist true or false; absent on older records means preserve their existing cutoff as absolute.

start_window.description: Effective original production start-window length in nanoseconds, retained across recovery. Available before startup; absent for experiments.

wall_time.description: Execution allowance, distinct from runtime estimates. Expiry/remaining appear after Started; elapsed grace or terminal state does not prove release.

execution.description: Immutable producing child job ID and accepted attempt for a selected-piece edge; zero value for a whole-parent edge.

executions.description: Whole-parent edge: accepted producing executions keyed by mapped producer piece. Immutable across retry and restart.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical Go JSON for files (sorted keys, compact encoding), verified at recovery time.

requested_by.description: Operator-asserted requester label, not a separately authenticated user identity.

docker.description: Opt-in managed direct docker run argv with a local digest-pinned image. With files or outputs: worker-owned mounts, UID/GID, /myce/work working directory and environment only; caller mounts/env/workdir/user and shared_inputs are rejected. Requires Linux docker_files_v1 worker capability.

disk.description: Optional fallback input/output/checkpoint size hints in bytes; known measured manifests take precedence. Missing size evidence uses only the volume free floor.

files.description: SHA-256/size-addressed inputs. Native jobs stage into work; managed Docker file batches require docker_files_v1 and mount private copies read-only at /myce/inputs, preserving relative names. Cannot mix NAS inputs, caller workdir or shared_inputs with Docker.

outputs.description: Declared relative output names to relative publication prefixes. Managed Docker file batches write beneath /myce/work; only verified current-attempt outputs become output_refs after all writers settle.

start_window.description: Optional production relative start duration (Go duration string), greater than zero and at most 1h. Defaults to 150s; explicit start_by takes precedence.

submission_key.description: Exact project-scoped submission identity echo. Omitted for an unkeyed job.

wall_time.description: Optional positive per-attempt Go duration from accepted Started; omission is unlimited. Expiry follows ordinary command-failure policy, never infrastructure loss.

description: Generated from Job and Spec JSON types by TestWireSchemas. This is a reply schema, not submission validation: a cancelled reservation has a minimal zero-valued spec. x-contract marks stable identity/lifecycle fields versus diagnostic projections; reason text is never a machine contract. Optional fields follow Go omitempty; observation replies include spec_projection describing omitted spec fields, including files and run. Additional diagnostics may grow.
